text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Once again, I could not escape the wicked 
tempest... and this was the result.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
The wind that brings victory... How can I 
make it blow...?
choice_data_list: But the wind isn't against us
You mustn't let your spirit waver.

choice_data_list: But the wind isn't against us

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list:
If I keep moving forward without stopping, 
I can get results!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
……The wind is fickle. No one knows when it 
will blow next……

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Surely a favorable wind will blow 
next time—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No, I will— I will make the wind blow...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I'm sorry. I let my weakness get the 
better of me...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: The wind blows for those who seek it...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I'm going to believe in myself a 
little longer. Next time for sure, I know 
I can whip up my own wind...!
